title: Neurosymbolic Learning for Inference-Time Argumentation
abstract: arXiv:2605.20098v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Claim verification is an important problem in high-stakes settings, including health and finance. When information underpinning claims is incomplete or conflicting, uncertain answers may be more appropriate than binary true or false classifications. In all cases, faithful explanations of the considerations determining the final verdict are crucial. We introduce inference-time argumentation (ITA), a trainable neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification in which a formal argumentation semantics giving the strength of claims and arguments is used both (i) to guide LLM training as models learn to generate arguments for and against claims and assign them base scores (representing intrinsic strengths) and (ii) to compute ternary (true/false/uncertain) predictions from generated, scored arguments. As a result, at training time, argument generation and scoring can be optimised according to the quality of the induced argumentative

translated_title: 面向推理时论证的神经符号学习
translated_abstract: 声明验证是包括健康和金融在内的高风险领域中的一个重要问题。当支撑声明的信息不完整或相互冲突时，给出不确定的答案可能比二元的真假分类更为合适。在所有情况下，对决定最终判断的考量因素给出忠实的解释都至关重要。我们提出了推理时论证，这是一个用于三元声明验证的可训练神经符号框架，其中用于衡量声明和论证强度的形式化论证语义被用于两个方面：(i) 在模型学习为声明生成支持和反对的论证并为其分配基础分数（代表内在强度）时，指导大语言模型的训练；(ii) 从生成的、已评分的论证中计算三元（真/假/不确定）预测。因此，在训练阶段，论证的生成与评分可以根据所得论证质量进行优化。
tldr: 该论文提出推理时论证框架，利用形式化论证语义同时指导大语言模型生成并评分支持和反对声明的论证、以及计算三元（真/假/不确定）的可解释声明验证预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Inference-Time Argumentation (ITA), a neurosymbolic framework that uses formal argumentation semantics both to guide LLM training in generating and scoring pro/con arguments and to compute ternary (true/false/uncertain) claim verification predictions with faithful explanations.
